english.title: Erect / use apparatus for sound / speech / images for commercial purposes at Stansted Airport London
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without the prior permission of the Airport Company

(A)_[erected]_
(B)_[used]_

apparatus for the transmission, receipt, recording, reproduction or amplification of sound, speech or images for commercial purposes at Stansted Airport London
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 4(8) and 2(3) of the Stansted Airport - London Byelaws, 1996 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.

english.notes: This Byelaw describes an act which is prohibited unless the permission of the Airport Company has first been obtained or unless the act is performed by a person acting with lawful authority or excuse.
